name: no-unsafe-as-any
description: Disallow `as any` — a cast to any switches the type checker off for every use of the value downstream; it is the silencing cast in its purest form
fixHint: Type the value: parse it (parse, don't validate), narrow it with a type guard, or use `unknown` and narrow. In a test feeding deliberately ill-typed input, say so with `as unknown as T`.
